ns2:section.sectionText: This re-designed section of LAS 101 will help first-year students learn the skills to succeed in their university careers and develop relationships within the College of Liberal Arts and Sciences (LAS). In this section, students will be introduced to design thinking methods like empathizing, defining other points of view, wayfinding and reframing. Through those methods, students will understand the different disciplines in LAS, learn to value different viewpoints, learn to collaborate, and identify college and university resources for their success. Students will be challenged to Inquire, Engage and Create.
